arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

Please find below the Q1 market data information for Acme from my client briefing records. Let me know if you have any questions or need further details.

Summary of Q1 Market Data for Acme (from client briefings):

- Category share (protein bars): Jan 6 – 18.4% (share up 60bps QoQ, US total, Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1), Feb 3 – 18.6% (share holding, US total), Mar 8 – 18.9% (share continuing to grow, US total, Nielsen March pull)
- Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): Jan 12 – 4.7 units/store/week (steady, top-3 SKU in category), Feb 8 – 4.9 units/store/week (uptick due to Q1 promo), Mar 18 – 5.1 units/store/week (best Q1 reading, momentum continues)
- Regional momentum: Jan 15 – Southeast +12% YoY (strongest region), Feb 16 – West +8% YoY (below plan, competitive pressure), Mar 25 – Northeast +9% YoY (steady, no notable competitive shifts)
- Promo lift: Jan 23 – +22% during MLK weekend reset (outperformed planned +15%), Feb 27 – +18% during Super Bowl window (met plan)
- Share of voice (digital): Feb 22 – 33% of category SOV (leading category, Verdant at 24%), Mar 30 – 34% of category SOV (steady leadership)

If you would like the underlying detailed CSV briefing, please let me know and I'll forward the file.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
